This event qualifies because the 2026 live pairing is directly tied to Adrian Sherwood's In a Space Outta Dub, which dismantles and rebuilds Nightmares On Wax's In a Space Outta Sound twenty years after the original, with SILENT POETS appearing as a Japanese dub ensemble. events.factual_description: BEATINK presents Adrian Sherwood presents DUB SESSIONS 2026 at Spotify O-EAST in Tokyo on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, with Adrian Sherwood vs Nightmares On Wax, support from SILENT POETS (DUB ENSEMBLE), and live painting by Peter Harris. The official promoter page lists open/start at 18:00 and general-sale tickets at ¥8,000 before the separate drink charge. BEATINK frames the collaboration around the 20th anniversary of Nightmares On Wax's 2006 album In a Space Outta Sound and Adrian Sherwood's 2026 dub reconstruction In a Space Outta Dub. The same bill continues to Yogibo META VALLEY in Osaka on September 10. Eplus independently confirms the September 9 Spotify O-EAST performance, the billed acts, 18:00 start, and active general sale.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a generic electronic double bill. In a Space Outta Dub takes the material of Nightmares On Wax's In a Space Outta Sound and lets Adrian Sherwood dismantle and rebuild it twenty years later, so putting both artists into the same DUB SESSIONS room makes production language itself — sub-bass, echo, negative space and sound-system logic — the subject of the night. SILENT POETS' special dub ensemble adds a real Japanese lineage to the bill rather than functioning as arbitrary support.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this if dub, sound-system culture and electronic groove are part of the Tokyo thread. O-EAST gives the collaboration a strong Tokyo setting, while the same bill in Osaka the next night means there is useful flexibility rather than a reason to reorganize the larger Japan trip around this one date.
en.listen_before: Nightmares On Wax & Adrian Sherwood — In a Space Outta Dub; Nightmares On Wax — In a Space Outta Sound

es.why_it_matters: No es un double bill electrónico armado al azar. In a Space Outta Dub toma el material de In a Space Outta Sound de Nightmares On Wax y deja que Adrian Sherwood lo desarme y lo vuelva a construir veinte años después; poner a los dos en el mismo DUB SESSIONS vuelve al propio lenguaje de producción —sub-bass, eco, espacio negativo y lógica de sound system— el centro de la noche. El ensamble especial de SILENT POETS añade además una genealogía japonesa de dub muy concreta, no un telonero puesto porque sí.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente si dub, cultura de sound system y groove electrónico forman parte del hilo de Tokio. O-EAST da un contexto fuerte para esa colaboración, mientras la misma alineación en Osaka al día siguiente ofrece suficiente flexibilidad como para no reorganizar el viaje completo por esta sola fecha.
